_example_note: Demonstration artifact for contracts/predict-view-customization.schema.json. This example defines presentation-only customization metadata for the churn-risk-overview predict view. Field hints reference public contract field names for the telco-customer-churn dataset. No validation rules, domain constraints, or inference behavior is included.

view_copy.heading: Churn Risk Assessment
view_copy.description: Estimate the likelihood that a telecommunications customer will cancel their service.
view_copy.usage_guidance: Enter the customer profile below. Use the canonical dataset contracts for required fields, accepted values, and runtime validation.

field_hints.explanatory_copy: How long the customer has been with the provider. Longer tenure is often associated with lower churn risk.
The customer's current monthly charge. Higher charges may correlate with increased churn risk.
Total amount charged over the customer's lifetime with the provider.
The customer's current contract commitment. Month-to-month contracts have higher churn rates in historical data.
The type of internet service the customer subscribes to.
How the customer pays their monthly bill.
